## Summary

**Add screenshot and accessibility regression matrix**

Current screenshots reveal width-sensitive failures but no automated prevention is shown.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P3**
- Wave: **V4**
- Complexity: **L**
- Audit code: `UX-P3-02`
- DUX code: `DUX5-31`

## Scope

All dashboards.

Screenshot groups: all screenshot groups + viewport matrix

## Concrete change

Render target states at 1366×768, 1440×900, 1920×1080, 100/125% zoom, supported themes. Check clipping, scrollbars, text floors and contrast tokens.

## Expected effect

Readability defects become merge-blocking rather than incident-time discoveries.

## Acceptance criteria

- Before/after screenshots stored; defined assertions pass; dark theme verified and light theme either verified or explicitly unsupported.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Grafana renderer/browser automation.

## Risk

Screenshot tests can be brittle; use semantic thresholds and stable fixtures.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

Extends DUX4-41 live screenshot regression with a11y + text floors.

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX5 epic (#7116)
